name: effort-optimizer
description: Judges each prompt with Haiku and suggests a better effort level in a band above the prompt (Apply or Dismiss). Apply overrides the effort of the main chat's requests without touching your saved effort setting. Never blocks a turn and never touches subagents.

minConfidence.title: Minimum confidence
minConfidence.description: Only suggest a level when the judge is at least this sure (0 to 1).

cooldownTurns.title: Cooldown (prompts)
cooldownTurns.description: After a suggestion, judge nothing for this many prompts.

mode.title: Default mode
mode.description: suggest shows a band with Apply and Dismiss, auto applies the level without asking, off does nothing. /effort-optimizer changes it for you.
